2: Sickness or Injury: Roll on the Injury table of the Core Rulebook.
3: Spouse Death: One of your wives dies unexpectedly but without suspicious circumstances. Lose one wife.
4: Enmity Begins: You gain an Enemy among your own people.
5: Rivalry Begins: You gain a Rival among your own people.
6: Hurried Marriage: You have to marry one of your daughters or close female relatives off quickly when her arranged match falls through. She marries beneath her station. Her new family hopes to take advantage of the situation.
7: Contact: You gain a potentially useful Contact.
8: Relocation: Your herd is ordered to move to a new world, causing significant upheaval.
9: Good Marriage: You arrange a marriage for one of your daughters or female relatives to a good family. Roll 1D — the family head becomes a Contact on 1-4 or an Ally on 5-6.
10: Accusations: You are accused of something really bad, like failing to venerate your ancestors or disrespecting your Steppelord. The ensuing wrangling takes up a lot of time. Lose D3 Benefit rolls.
11: Feud: Your clan or herd becomes involved in a bitter feud with rivals. Gain D3 Enemies and an Ally among your own people.
12: Unusual Event: Roll one of the unusual events from the standard Life Events table or consult the Referee for something truly extraordinary.
